steps.name: h1-1-hub-site-import
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && cd tools/orb-manager && /usr/local/go/bin/go vet ./... && /usr/local/go/bin/go test -run 'SiteImport|SiteLink|SiteBundle|SiteKeep|ThemeOrigin' . && /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./... && cd ../.. && test -z "$(git diff --stat a2ec9a0 -- tools/orb-manager/contract/)"

steps.name: h1-2-session-import
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest && node headless-gorbhost.test.js | tail -3 | grep -q 'all green' && node headless-session.test.js | tail -1 | grep -q 'all green' && PY=python3 node headless-test.js && cd $R/apps/clock/editor/_selftest && node headless-test.js && GORB_HOST='{"kind":"hub"}' NODE_OPTIONS="--require=$R/tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/gorb-host-preload.js" node headless-test.js && cd $R && test -z "$(git diff a2ec9a0 -- tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/headless-gorbhost.test.js | grep '^-[^-]')" && make check-web && make check-runner && python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py check-migrations apps/clock/ apps/flights/ apps/weather/ apps/radar/ apps/color_picker/ && node -e "for (const f of ['tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/session.js','tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/send.js']) new Function(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"

steps.name: h1-3-themes-tab-import
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/tabs.js && go test -run 'SiteImport|AppJS|ThemeEditor|ThemeRows' . && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd web/runtime/_selftest && PY=python3 node headless-test.js && node headless-gorbhost.test.js | tail -3 | grep -q 'all green' && cd $R && make check-web
